description: This file contains functions for managing database operations related to repositories, code files, and embeddings, including fetching, updating, storing, and retrieving repository and file data, as well as processing source code files and their embeddings.

methods.name: fetch_all_embeddings
methods.description: Fetches all embeddings for a given repository based on repo_info and comment_id.

methods.name: fetch_corpus_embeddings
methods.description: Fetches embeddings for a specific corpus within a repository.

methods.name: update_sha
methods.description: Updates the commit SHA of a repository in the database.

methods.name: update_embeddings_in_db
methods.description: Updates the database with new, modified, or removed file embeddings.

methods.name: send_initialized_data_to_db
methods.description: Stores repository info and code files with embeddings into the database.

methods.name: retrieve_stored_sha
methods.description: Retrieves the stored commit SHA for a repository.

methods.name: retrieve_sha_from_db
methods.description: Retrieves the latest stored commit SHA from the database.

methods.name: insert_to_code_db
methods.description: Reads a code file, detects encoding, and stores its content in the database.

methods.name: process_and_patch_embeddings
methods.description: Processes repository files, updates embeddings, and manages source code files in the database.

methods.name: retrieve_repo_file_contents
methods.description: Retrieves contents of repository files based on a query.
